jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner - Manitoba
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Founded in 2019, Felix is a patient-driven digital healthcare company that puts you in control of your health and wellbeing. We’re passionate about building technology and beautiful customer experiences to make healthcare more accessible (and more enjoyable) for all Canadians. Our strong venture partners provide us the resources to support our rapid growth and we are continuing to build our incredible team based in Toronto. Felix is Canada's first end-to-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery and ongoing care across a growing range of categories such as birth control, erectile dysfunction, acne and more.‍

Description

We are looking for innovative Nurse Practitioners to join our telemedicine platform. At the cutting edge of telemedicine, Felix connects patients with medical professionals to help them address and treat their lifestyle health concerns. If you are interested in joining a team of healthcare practitioners providing quality online care to patients throughout Canada, then check out the advantages of joining our team. Currently we are looking for a Nurse Practitioner licensed in Manitoba.


Advantages of joining Felix include

Work from the comfort of your home and see patients at whatever time of day you are available from your laptop, iPhone or iPad

  • Easy to use platform built to comply with PHIPA privacy regulations and prove a secure experience for NPs, physicians and patients

  • Work from home, while in the office, and while traveling. Work part-time and flexible hours that you decide (i.e. weekends, nights)


Who you are

  • Seeking a Nurse Practitioner with cross-jurisdictional licensure, preferably holding licenses in both Manitoba (MB) and British Columbia (BC).

  • Nurse Practitioner with 2+ years of experience, committed to providing patients with the best possible care.

  • Nurse Practitioner physically located and licensed in Manitoba, with a Manitoba Billing number, required for ordering laboratory testing.

  • Available to provide a minimum of 8 hours of scheduled time per week on the platform.

  • Member in good standing of the College(s) where they hold the title of Nurse Practitioner, maintaining eligibility and willingness to be licensed in other provinces.

  • NP who maintains confidentiality and follows the code of conduct as per the governing body of their province/territory.

  • Experience with telemedicine, weight loss, menopause, mental health, ED, and birth control care are assets.

  • Nurse practitioner with a proficient understanding of computers, technology, and remote work.


Compensation

  • Nurse practitioners are compensated on a per assessment basis


Our commitment to an inclusive team culture means embracing diversity and offering equitable access to opportunities and resources for people who might otherwise be excluded. During our recruitment process, we provide accommodations at any stage. Candidates can communicate their accommodation needs to the hiring manager directly or by emailing accessibility@felixforyou.ca.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Please note: We have been made aware of fraudulent recruiting activities where individuals pose as Felix representatives.

  • Communication: We will only ever contact you from an official @felixforyou.ca email address.

  • Interviews: All interviews are conducted via Google Meet; we never interview via text-only platforms (like Telegram or WhatsApp).

  • Payments: We will never ask for credit card information, bank details, or payments for "equipment" or "onboarding" during the application process.

If you receive a suspicious request, please do not provide any personal information and report it to us immediately at hr@felixforyou.ca

jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner - British Columbia
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Founded in 2019, Felix is a digital healthcare company that puts the patient in control of their own health and wellbeing. We’re passionate about building technology and beautiful customer experiences to make healthcare more accessible (and more enjoyable) for all Canadians.

Felix is Canada's first end-to-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery and ongoing care. We deliver care across a growing range of daily health categories such as weight loss, birth control, menopause, erectile dysfunction, acne and more.‍

Description

We are looking for innovative Nurse Practitioners to join our growing team of healthcare providers. At the cutting edge of virtual care, Felix connects patients with medical professionals to help them address and treat their lifestyle health concerns.

If you are interested in joining a team of healthcare practitioners and are driven to provide quality online care across Canada, then check out the advantages to joining our team!

We are currently looking for a Nurse Practitioner licensed in British Columbia. Preference will be given to NPs with additional licensing.

Advantages of joining Felix:

  • Work from the comfort of your home, on your laptop, computer. You can even work on the go via our HCP portal available on mobiles or iPads.

  • Flexible hours: you pick the hours you want to work (weekends, evenings).

  • Take the vacation you want, when you want it.

  • Join a community of healthcare professionals, working at the cutting edge of virtual healthcare, to share and learn from each other.

  • Opportunities to connect with some of Canada’s leading physicians in Weight Loss, Menopause and virtual care.

  • Easy to use platform, with on hand engineering and clinical support.

  • A platform that is secure for both the patient and health professional, which has been purpose built to comply with PHIPA privacy regulations.


Who you are

  • Felix is seeking a Nurse Practitioner with license in British Columbia (BC), preferably with cross-jurisdictional licensure.

  • You have 2+ years of Nurse Practitioner experience, with demonstrated experience of providing patients with the best possible care.

  • You are physically located in British Columbia, with a BC billing number, required for ordering laboratory testing.

  • You are available to provide a minimum of 8 hours of scheduled time per week on the platform, in addition to logging in every 24-48hrs to address patient needs. 

  • You are a member in good standing of the College(s) where they hold the title of Nurse Practitioner, maintaining eligibility and willingness to be licensed in other provinces.

  • You maintain confidentiality and follow the code of conduct as per the governing body of their province/territory.

  • You have experience in telemedicine. Additional experience in weight loss, menopause, mental health, ED, and birth control care are assets.

  • You have a proficient understanding of technology, EMRs and remote work.

  • You are adaptable and open to change.


Compensation

  • Nurse practitioners are compensated on a per assessment basis

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.

jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner, Menopause & Women's Health
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Founded in 2019, Felix is Canada's first end-to-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery, and ongoing care across a growing range of categories, including birth control, erectile dysfunction, acne, and more.

We’re a patient-driven, direct to consumer, digital healthcare company that puts patients in control of their health and wellbeing, as well as making healthcare more accessible for all Canadians.

We deliver care across a growing range of daily health categories such as weight loss & metabolic health, birth control, menopause, erectile dysfunction, acne and more.‍

Description

We are looking for innovative Nurse Practitioners with a passion for Women’s Health and Menopause to join our growing team of healthcare providers. If you have additional training or great experience in women’s health, we want to hear from you!

We are currently looking for a Nurse Practitioner licensed in at least one province in Canada. Preference will be given to NPs with multiple licensing, or with licensing that meets our current needs. 

Advantages of joining Felix:

  • Felix-ability: You pick the hours you want to work

  • 100% remote: from the comfort of your home, on your laptop, computer or even on your mobile and tablets.

  • Unlimited vacation: take what you want, when you want it

  • Leading virtual medicine provider in Canada: work at the cutting edge of virtual healthcare

  • Professional Development: plenty of opportunities to connect and learn from some of Canada’s leading physicians

  • Safety is our priority: our platform is secure for both the patient and health professional and has been purpose built to comply with PHIPA privacy regulations.

  • Intuitive platform: The Felix platform is easy to use, plus HCPs have continuous on-hand engineering and clinical support available to them. 

Who you are:

  • A licensed Nurse Practitioner in at least one Canadian province, preferably with multiple province licensure.

  • You are a member in good standing of the College(s) where you hold the title of Nurse Practitioner.

  • You are physically located in Canada, with a billing number required for ordering laboratory testing.

  • You have at least 2+ years of Nurse Practitioner experience, with demonstrated experience providing menopause care.

  • Additional certifications or training in the menopause or women’s health fields are a plus.

  • You are available to provide a minimum of 8 hours per week on the platform, in addition to logging in a minimum of every 48 hours to address patient updates. 

  • You maintain confidentiality and follow the code of conduct as per the governing body of their province/territory.

  • You have experience in telemedicine. Additional experience in weight loss & metabolic health, mental health, erectile dysfunction, and birth control care are assets.

  • You have a proficient understanding of technology, EMRs and remote work.

  • You are adaptable and open to change. 

Compensation

  • Nurse practitioners are compensated on a per-assessment basis


Our commitment to an inclusive team culture means embracing diversity and offering equitable access to opportunities and resources for people who might otherwise be excluded. During our recruitment process, we provide accommodations at any stage. Candidates can communicate their accommodation needs to the hiring manager directly or by emailing accessibility@felixforyou.ca.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Please note: We have been made aware of fraudulent recruiting activities where individuals pose as Felix representatives.

  • Communication: We will only ever contact you from an official @felixforyou.ca email address.

  • Interviews: All interviews are conducted via Google Meet; we never interview via text-only platforms (like Telegram or WhatsApp).

  • Payments: We will never ask for credit card information, bank details, or payments for "equipment" or "onboarding" during the application process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Hiring Process

Felix Health may use AI-driven tools to screen and assess applications for this position. These tools may perform an initial review, sort, and/or score job applications based on the minimum qualifications and other job-related criteria as outlined in this posting. All final decisions regarding hiring will be made by the hiring manager.
